fact: Car 5 left the track in turn 11
offence: Alleged breach of Article B1.8.6 of the FIA F1 Regulations.
reason: The Stewards reviewed positioning/marshalling system data, video, and in-car video evidence. At the entry to turn 11, Car 5 (Gabriel Bortoleto) moved to overtake Car 43 (Franco Colapinto) on the outside. Car 43 stayed alongside and in that battle Car 5 left the edge of the track and rejoined ahead of Car 43. Under the Driving Standards Guidelines, had the front axle of Car 5 been ahead at the apex, Car 5 would have been entitled to racing room on the inside. There was no racing room on the inside which explained why Car 5 left the edge of the track. Had the front axle of Car 43 been ahead of the front axle of Car 5 at the apex, Car 43 was not obliged to leave racing room on the outside. The Stewards were unable, by reference to the available evidence, to reach a level of comfortable satisfaction as to which of the two cars was ahead at the apex and in these circumstances determined to take no further action.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Decision Car 5 Alleged Leaving The Track And Gaining And Advantage
